summaries.senate: Polymarket odds for Democratic control of the Senate rose sharply, with the party now the market's favoured side. The Democrat Annie Andrews in [[South Carolina]] and the Democrat Adam Hamilton in [[Kansas]] both gained ground sharply, and each race is now a predicted flip. The projected seat count recently changed to 55-45, up from 55-44-1, which means Democrats gain control.
summaries.governor: Polymarket odds moved sharply in four governor's races over the last day. In [[Texas]], the Democrat Gina Hinojosa gained a lot of ground and is now a predicted flip, and the market also sees the Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms in [[Georgia]] making a sharp gain, another predicted flip. The Democrat in [[Kansas]], Cindy Holscher, and the Republican in Florida, Byron Donalds, each saw their chances climb sharply as well.
summaries.house: Polymarket odds for Democrats to control the House rose by a sizable amount, and the market continues to favour them. The projected seat count recently changed to 263-171-1, up from 263-172, which would mean Democrats gain control, and [[AK-AL (Alaska)]] is a newly predicted flip. The Democrats J. D.
